Opportunity Overview
Handshake is looking for Bahasa Indonesian speakers based in Indonesia to help make AI responses more personalized. This is not a traditional job — you'll share your own real-world experience using ChatGPT and help evaluate and rank AI responses so future models can better tailor their answers to individual users.
This is an ongoing, project-based opportunity you can take on alongside your current role.
Gambaran Peluang
Handshake sedang mencari penutur Bahasa Indonesia yang berdomisili di Indonesia untuk membantu membuat respons AI menjadi lebih personal. Ini bukan pekerjaan tradisional — Anda akan membagikan pengalaman nyata Anda menggunakan ChatGPT dan membantu mengevaluasi serta membandingkan respons AI agar model di masa depan dapat menyesuaikan jawabannya dengan lebih baik untuk setiap pengguna.
Ini adalah kesempatan berbasis proyek yang berkelanjutan, yang dapat Anda lakukan bersamaan dengan pekerjaan Anda saat ini.
What You'll Do
Complete tasks on Handshake's annotation platform using your own real-world experience with AI tools
Compare and evaluate AI-generated responses, sharing your honest preferences and reasoning
Provide clear written feedback that helps AI better understand and personalize responses for individual users
Complete tasks at your own pace with no set schedule or minimum hour requirement
Yang Akan Anda Lakukan
Menyelesaikan tugas di platform anotasi Handshake dengan menggunakan pengalaman nyata Anda sendiri dalam menggunakan alat AI
Membandingkan dan mengevaluasi respons yang dihasilkan oleh AI, dengan membagikan preferensi dan alasan Anda secara jujur
Memberikan masukan tertulis yang jelas untuk membantu AI lebih memahami dan mempersonalisasi respons bagi setiap pengguna
Menyelesaikan tugas sesuai kecepatan Anda sendiri, tanpa jadwal tetap atau jumlah jam minimum yang diwajibkan
Qualifications
Ideal candidates meet all of the following:
Location — Based in Indonesia and able to work remotely in an asynchronous, self-directed capacity
Language — Fluent in Bahasa Indonesian, both written and spoken, with strong written communication skills for explaining your reasoning clearly. Good working understanding of English (ideally B2 level) as the platform, instructions, and training materials will all be in English.
AI experience — Prior hands-on experience using ChatGPT or similar AI chat assistants, with enough familiarity to compare responses thoughtfully and articulate what makes one answer better suited to a given user than another
Judgment — Comfortable forming and defending your own preferences between two AI-generated responses, even when the differences are subtle
Kualifikasi
Kandidat yang ideal memenuhi semua kriteria berikut:
Lokasi — Berdomisili di Indonesia dan dapat bekerja secara remote dengan cara asinkron dan mandiri
Bahasa — Mahir dalam Bahasa Indonesia, baik lisan maupun tulisan, dengan kemampuan komunikasi tulisan yang baik untuk menjelaskan alasan Anda secara jelas. Memiliki pemahaman kerja yang baik terhadap Bahasa Inggris (idealnya level B2), karena platform, instruksi, dan materi pelatihan akan menggunakan Bahasa Inggris.
Pengalaman dengan AI — Memiliki pengalaman langsung menggunakan ChatGPT atau asisten AI serupa, dengan pemahaman yang cukup untuk membandingkan respons secara cermat dan menjelaskan alasan mengapa satu jawaban lebih sesuai untuk pengguna tertentu dibandingkan jawaban lainnya
Penilaian — Merasa nyaman dalam membentuk dan mempertahankan preferensi Anda sendiri di antara dua respons yang dihasilkan AI, meskipun perbedaannya bersifat halus
Required for all applicants
Comfortable sharing your own ChatGPT conversation history for research and product improvement purposes (handled confidentially)
Strong written communication in Bahasa Indonesian, with a good working understanding of English
Ability to work independently in a remote, asynchronous environment
Persyaratan untuk Semua Pelamar
Bersedia membagikan riwayat percakapan ChatGPT Anda sendiri untuk keperluan penelitian dan peningkatan produk (dikelola secara rahasia)
Kemampuan komunikasi tulisan yang baik dalam Bahasa Indonesia, dengan pemahaman kerja yang baik terhadap Bahasa Inggris
Mampu bekerja secara mandiri dalam lingkungan remote dan asinkron

Opportunity Overview
Handshake is looking for Japanese speakers based in Japan to help make AI responses more personalized. This is not a traditional job — you'll share your own real-world experience using ChatGPT and help evaluate and rank AI responses so future models can better tailor their answers to individual users.
This is an ongoing, project-based opportunity you can take on alongside your current role.
募集概要
Handshakeでは、日本に在住し日本語を話す方を募集しています。AIの応答をよりパーソナライズされたものにするお手伝いをしていただきます。これは従来の仕事とは異なります — あなた自身がChatGPTを使った実際の経験を共有し、AIが生成した応答を評価・比較していただくことで、将来のモデルが個々のユーザーに合わせた回答をより的確に提供できるようになります。
これは継続的なプロジェクト単位の機会であり、現在のお仕事と並行して取り組んでいただけます。
What You'll Do
Complete tasks on Handshake's annotation platform using your own real-world experience with AI tools
Compare and evaluate AI-generated responses, sharing your honest preferences and reasoning
Provide clear written feedback that helps AI better understand and personalize responses for individual users
Complete tasks at your own pace with no set schedule or minimum hour requirement
業務内容
Handshakeのアノテーションプラットフォームで、AIツールを使った実際のご自身の経験をもとにタスクを完了する
AIが生成した応答を比較・評価し、正直な好みとその理由を共有する
AIが個々のユーザーに合わせて応答をより良く理解・パーソナライズできるよう、明確な文章によるフィードバックを提供する
決まったスケジュールや最低作業時間の縛りなく、自分のペースでタスクを完了する
Qualifications
Ideal candidates meet all of the following:
Location — Based in Japan and able to work remotely in an asynchronous, self-directed capacity
Language — Fluent in Japanese, both written and spoken, with strong written communication skills for explaining your reasoning clearly. Good working understanding of English (ideally B2 level) as the platform, instructions, and training materials will all be in English.
AI experience — Prior hands-on experience using ChatGPT or similar AI chat assistants, with enough familiarity to compare responses thoughtfully and articulate what makes one answer better suited to a given user than another
Judgment — Comfortable forming and defending your own preferences between two AI-generated responses, even when the differences are subtle
応募資格
理想的な候補者は、以下をすべて満たしています:
居住地 — 日本に在住しており、非同期・自主的な形でリモート勤務が可能であること
言語 — 日本語(読み書き・会話ともに)に堪能で、自分の判断理由を明確に説明できる高い文章力を持っていること。プラットフォーム、指示事項、研修資料はすべて英語で提供されるため、英語を実務レベルで理解できること(できればB2レベル)も必要です。
AI経験 — ChatGPTまたは類似のAIチャットアシスタントを実際に使用した経験があり、応答を注意深く比較し、あるユーザーにとってどちらの回答がより適切かを説明できるだけの理解があること
判断力 — 2つのAI生成応答の違いが微妙な場合でも、自分自身の好みを形成し、それを説明・主張できること
Required for all applicants
Comfortable sharing your own ChatGPT conversation history for research and product improvement purposes (handled confidentially)
Strong written communication in Japanese, with good understanding of English
Ability to work independently in a remote, asynchronous environment
全応募者共通の必須条件
研究および製品改善の目的で、自身のChatGPTの会話履歴を共有することに抵抗がないこと(内容は機密として取り扱われます)
日本語での高い文章力と、英語の実務レベルの理解力を有すること
リモート・非同期環境で自主的に業務を遂行できること
About sharing your ChatGPT history
We'd like to take a moment to explain why we ask for your ChatGPT conversation history and how it will be used.
Your history helps us create evaluation tasks that are personal to you. During the project, you'll revisit questions you've previously asked ChatGPT and evaluate how well different AI responses match your own preferences — things like tone, warmth, or writing style. There are no right or wrong answers. We're simply interested in your honest impressions.
We understand your conversation history may include private content. You're welcome to delete anything you'd prefer not to share before submitting. We just ask that at least 41 conversations remain afterward. A "conversation" means an individual chat session, not each message within it.
Everything you share will be handled with care and used only for research and product improvement.
ChatGPT履歴のご提供について
ChatGPTの会話履歴をご提供いただくお願いをするにあたり、その目的と活用方法についてご説明させていただきます。
ご提供いただいた履歴は、参加者お一人おひとりに合わせた評価タスクの作成に活用させていただきます。タスクでは、過去にChatGPTへ入力されたご自身の質問やリクエストをもとに、異なるAIの応答があなたの好みにどれだけ沿っているかを評価していただきます。応答の温かみ、文体やトーンの好み、絵文字の自然さなどが評価の対象となります。正解・不正解はございません。あくまでご自身の率直な印象をお聞かせいただければ幸いです。
会話履歴には個人的な内容が含まれる場合もあるかと存じます。共有したくない会話は、ご提出前にあらかじめ削除していただいて構いません。ただし、削除後も少なくとも41件以上の会話が残っていることが参加の条件となります。ここでの「会話」とは、個々のメッセージではなく、個別のチャットセッションを指します。
ご提供いただいた履歴は、研究および製品改善のみを目的として、厳重に機密管理のもとで大切に取り扱わせていただきます。

Overview
Handshake is seeking experienced Technical Writers and documentation professionals to support AI research through flexible, hourly contract work. This is not a traditional full-time technical writing, documentation, or content development role. Instead, you'll apply your real-world experience creating, editing, and refining technical documentation to evaluate AI-generated content and provide feedback that helps AI produce clearer, more accurate, and user-friendly technical writing. Your expertise will help improve AI's understanding of technical accuracy, documentation structure, clarity, consistency, voice, tone, and adherence to professional writing standards.
This is an ongoing, project-based opportunity that can be done alongside your primary employment.

This project involves using your professional experience and hands-on knowledge of the tools you use in your daily work to create expert-level training data and evaluate AI-generated responses for accuracy and relevance. No prior AI experience required.

Proven experience creating original technical content, editing drafts, and refining voice and tone for diverse audiences
Exceptional written communication skills with strong attention to detail
Ability to work independently while following detailed written guidelines
Demonstrated professionalism, sound judgment, and a commitment to handling sensitive or proprietary information with discretion
No prior AI or technical background required

What You’ll Do
Use your vascular technology expertise to create expert-level tasks that today’s top AI models can’t solve, based on real vascular lab workflows such as duplex ultrasound acquisition, Doppler waveform analysis, physiologic testing (ABI, segmental pressures, and plethysmography), vessel stenosis and thrombosis assessment, and preliminary findings and reporting
Review and evaluate AI-generated responses for technical accuracy, patient safety, and alignment with current vascular testing practice and professional guidelines
Provide clear, structured written feedback to help improve AI model performance
Work remotely and complete tasks at your own pace, with no set schedule or minimum hour requirement
Qualifications
Education: Completed an accredited sonography program and must hold a bachelor’s degree
Credential: Currently holds the Registered Vascular Technologist (RVT) credential from ARDMS, or the equivalent Registered Vascular Specialist (RVS) credential from Cardiovascular Credentialing International (CCI)
Clinical depth: Working knowledge in one or more of the following areas:
Lower and upper extremity arterial duplex and physiologic testing
Venous duplex, including DVT evaluation and venous insufficiency mapping
Carotid and cerebrovascular duplex, including transcranial Doppler
Abdominal vascular studies, including renal, mesenteric, and aortic imaging
Dialysis access and vein mapping
Post-intervention surveillance, including stents, grafts, and endovascular aneurysm repair (EVAR)
Waveform analysis and hemodynamic assessment
Additional qualifications (not required, but strengthen your application)
Additional credentials, such as RDMS or RDCS, or experience across multiple vascular and ultrasound specialties
Experience in an accredited vascular lab (e.g., IAC-accredited), academic medical center, or vascular surgery practice, experience training students or new technologists, or familiarity with reporting and image management systems
Required for all applicants
Must have US work authorization
Strong written communication and attention to detail
Ability to explain complex vascular testing concepts clearly
Ability to work independently in a remote, asynchronous environment
